resolved_conflicts.explanation: The commission's own history gives October 1, 1993 for closing its tower system; the Post and Courier gives 1994 for decommissioning. Both are kept as separate dates.

notes_for_editor: Only the lookout-history stub, a TopoQuest nearby-feature row (3.5 miles from the Brittons Neck place) and an OpenStreetMap node (357095299; ele 13, tower:type observation, tower:construction lattice) name this tower. The lattice tag is OpenStreetMap-only and uncorroborated, and the story says so by attributing it. No build, staffing or status source was found. The TopoQuest page is the populated-place page for Brittons Neck, not a tower page, so its coordinates were not used.
